description: This file contains utility functions and algorithms for handling the sharding and resharding of tensors in a distributed setting, specifically within PyTorch's distributed module. It includes functions to compute shard metadata, perform local shard reshuffling, and coordinate tensor distribution across multiple devices.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: A class representing a shard of a tensor, holding the tensor data and its metadata.

methods.name: int get_idx_from_placements(placements, current_rank)
methods.description: Returns the index of the current rank within the given placements list, based on the rank of each placement.

methods.name: tuple[list[ShardMetadata],list[int]] build_reshard_metadata( st_size: torch.Size, sharding_spec: shard_spec.ShardingSpec, world_size: int, )
methods.description: Generates metadata for each shard based on the sharding specification, including offsets, local sizes, and device placement.

methods.name: tuple[list[Shard],list[ShardMetadata]] reshuffle_local_shard( local_shard: torch.Tensor, st_size: torch.Size, sharding_spec: shard_spec.ShardingSpec, resharding_spec: shard_spec.ShardingSpec, pg: ProcessGroup, )
methods.description: Performs a direct reshuffle of the local shard when the resharding dimension is the same as the original sharding dimension, involving an all-to-all communication pattern.

methods.name: tuple[list[Shard],list[ShardMetadata]] reshard_local_shard( local_tensor: torch.Tensor, st_size: torch.Size, sharding_spec: shard_spec.ShardingSpec, resharding_spec: shard_spec.ShardingSpec, pg: ProcessGroup, )
methods.description: Handles reshaping and redistribution of a local tensor shard when the resharded dimension differs from the original sharding dimension, involving tensor selection and all-to-all communication.
